steps.title: Open Tapeology
steps.narration: Let's start on Tapeology's home page, the Cockpit.
steps.point_out: The top navigation bar now ends with a new tab called Structure.

steps.title: Open the new Structure page
steps.narration: Clicking Structure opens a brand-new page for viewing a symbol's support and resistance levels.
steps.point_out: A fresh page appears with its own heading and a plain-language explanation of what it shows, plus Symbol, As-of, and Load controls waiting for input.

expect.text: Choose a symbol and an as-of time, then Load, to see its S/R levels and confluence zones.

steps.title: Type a symbol
steps.narration: Typing a symbol here works just like the search boxes used elsewhere in the app.
steps.point_out: PG now appears in the Symbol field.

steps.title: Set an as-of time
steps.narration: Adding an as-of date and time completes the query.
steps.point_out: The Load button switches from dim to fully solid the moment both fields are filled.

steps.title: Refresh the page
steps.narration: Before loading anything, let's refresh the page.
steps.point_out: The Symbol and As-of fields are empty again, and the same starting message reappears — the page deliberately doesn't remember the last query.

expect.text: Choose a symbol and an as-of time, then Load, to see its S/R levels and confluence zones.

steps.title: Type the symbol again
steps.narration: Typing the symbol again after the refresh.
steps.point_out: PG is back in the Symbol field.

steps.title: Set the as-of time again
steps.point_out: Both fields are filled, so Load is ready.

steps.title: Load PG's levels and zones
steps.narration: Clicking Load asks the research API for this symbol's real support-and-resistance levels and confluence zones — when history has been recorded for a symbol, this same page draws it on a candlestick chart with a zones table underneath.
steps.point_out: Right now the app is honest that no price history has been recorded yet for PG in this environment — never a blank page or a made-up chart.

expect.text: No bar series recorded for PG.

steps.title: Try an invalid date
steps.narration: Now let's deliberately type something that isn't a valid date.

steps.title: See the honest error state
steps.narration: Loading with a malformed date never crashes the page or leaves it blank.
steps.point_out: An amber-bordered panel shows the exact reason the request failed, plus a note that nothing cached or fabricated is shown in its place.

expect.text: as_of must be an ISO date-time

steps.title: Confirm Performance still works
steps.narration: Let's make sure an existing page still works exactly as before.
steps.point_out: The Performance page loads normally, with its profit-and-loss scorecard and champion strategy intact — and the Structure tab now sits alongside it in the nav.

steps.title: Go back to the Cockpit
steps.narration: Back to the Cockpit to check the original live-tape flow.
steps.point_out: The ticker box and green Watch button are right where they were.

steps.title: Type a simulated ticker
steps.narration: Typing in a simulated ticker to watch.
steps.point_out: SIM-BUYER appears in the ticker field.

steps.title: Watch a simulated tape
steps.narration: Watching a simulated tape still works exactly as it did before this update.
steps.point_out: Within moments, the Cockpit populates with a live quote, recent trades, and a tape-state reading of Buyer Control.
